Rejected over-limit saving preserves the previous valid stored value and reports a size-specific message rather than a generic browser-storage failure.
Existing unreadable raw storage is retained for explicit recovery and is not silently replaced by an initial blank-state edit.
Normal v1 files and existing size/shape validation remain compatible.
Use the exact UTF-8 byte threshold of 1048576 inclusive on the actual serialized representation, not JavaScript character count.
Test compact-to-canonical expansion and schema-default insertion before committing an import, as well as edit growth.
A rejected size write must not invoke setItem, must retain the previous valid stored value, and must have a size-specific unsaved status.
Ordinary export must never download an over-limit file with a message promising that it can be imported.
Unreadable stored data must remain protected through rendering, editing, undo and imports until an explicit replacement action succeeds.

completion_review.qualification: Scope and unexecuted-example limits remain as specified in the acceptance criteria and review evidence.

items.title: Expand matching through narrow reviewed workflows for existing deferred profiles
acceptance_criteria: Each new workflow has a particular language/input path and findings supported by named rule or query evidence.
A positive system, an incomplete system and an incompatible system produce candidate/details/no-match-or-blocked results appropriately.
Free/paid, CE/Pro and Community/Server capabilities remain separate.
New evidence URLs are included in tool sources and covered by existing metadata checks.
Update deferred coverage explanations when a profile gains its first workflow; retain unreviewed modes as omissions.
For CodeQL, pin CLI/query pack, selected query/suite and Python/framework/extraction/host scope; preserve CLI eligibility and separate query-library licenses.
For CE, select and review the exact rule/config revision and rule license before admitting a finding category; do not inherit Pro/cross-file capabilities.
Test metadata matching with positive, incomplete and incompatible descriptions without treating those tests as analyzer execution.
Keep other deferred products, S-TaLiRo availability/license and unreviewed language/edition combinations deferred.

completion_review.qualification: Scope and unexecuted-example limits remain as specified in the acceptance criteria and review evidence.

items.title: Add an execution-coverage workflow before treating test reach as understood
acceptance_criteria: Reader can identify the measured source scope, an unexecuted line and a missing branch in illustrative output.
The example distinguishes full line coverage from full branch coverage and from effective assertions.
State whether data covers one process or a configured process tree, and whether the run completed.
Link a single reusable test fixture/run record; retain an unexecuted label until later hands-on validation.
Add a precise coverage-measurement technique/result label without relabeling existing fuzzers as coverage-report tools.
Use one existing test runner, explicit source selection and --branch, and distinguish measured lines from possible branch destinations.
Record whether the run completed and whether only one process was measured.
Keep coverage threshold success distinct from test success and from effective assertions; advanced process modes remain out of initial scope.

completion_review.qualification: Scope and unexecuted-example limits remain as specified in the acceptance criteria and review evidence.

items.title: Separate mutation testing from input mutation and coverage counts
acceptance_criteria: Explain source mutation separately from changing fuzz inputs.
The first workflow uses an explicit small source subset and a working test runner.
Show how one meaningful surviving mutation can motivate a stronger assertion without demanding an arbitrary score of 100%.
Explain the treatment of errors/timeouts/exclusions and equivalent mutants.
Record tool, runner, target revision and mutation configuration; do not claim an illustrative run occurred.

Explicitly teach detected = killed + timeout, undetected = survived + no coverage, valid = detected + undetected, and score = detected/valid. Runtime/compile errors, ignored and pending are outside that denominator.
Distinguish a test failure that kills a mutant from a test-runner runtime error.
Keep temporary-copy execution, a small mutation scope and a successful baseline suite in the first route.
Use source mutation testing as a separate technique from input mutation; do not require 100% or infer universal test quality.

completion_review.qualification: Scope and unexecuted-example limits remain as specified in the acceptance criteria and review evidence.

items.title: Add a scoped Python runtime-profiling path
acceptance_criteria: Profile explains what a sampled stack means for the selected workload and interval.
Installation/setup link identifies release-specific interpreter/host scope.
Permission/setup failure is distinguished from successful recording.
Native, container and production claims are absent unless separately supported.
Label all sample profiles illustrative unless execution evidence is later retained.
Choose and document one release/host/interpreter combination; state process-read permissions for that route.
Show permission/setup failure separately from a completed recording. Do not offer broad security-setting changes as an assumed prerequisite.
Distinguish record output, live top summaries and dump snapshots rather than describing all as the same sampled artifact.
Keep native/container/production modes and automatic builder matching deferred.

completion_review.qualification: Scope and unexecuted-example limits remain as specified in the acceptance criteria and review evidence.

items.title: Add HTTP load testing with explicit workload and threshold semantics
acceptance_criteria: Reader can identify the endpoint, test-data/reset assumptions, workload, duration and pass/fail criteria.
Explain check versus threshold behavior and distinguish missing/failed setup from a passed measurement.
Record target revision/environment and load-generator conditions without claiming results transfer unchanged to production.
Comparison with Schemathesis/RESTler explains different questions rather than ranking generic API coverage.
Initial example uses a local disposable service or clearly bounded official tutorial, labeled unexecuted until validated.
Define endpoint, data/reset, load model, duration, functional checks and metric thresholds; include the conditions needed for a meaningful completed test.
Do not treat a zero process status with only failed checks as meeting the intended service goal.
Keep target language independent and cloud/browser/distributed/extension modes outside scope.

A reviewed HTTP workflow with a new performance finding can already be matched and displayed without a GOALS mapping. Adding a performance goal is optional future taxonomy/bookkeeping, not a current admission or discoverability prerequisite. Admission still requires exact workflow evidence and scoped inputs, requirements, findings and host qualifications.

completion_review.qualification: Scope and unexecuted-example limits remain as specified in the acceptance criteria and review evidence.

items.title: Add focused cross-surface regressions when fixing confirmed UI problems
acceptance_criteria: Static/Dynamic -> profile -> return and catalog -> comparison -> return are covered with expected category, query and selection.
System save/reload and import rejection are tested at the UI boundary when those flows change, using isolated origin/fixtures.
Confirmed API-preset membership and source-only citation rendering receive the cheapest meaningful generated/content assertions.
Tests verify reader outcomes rather than copying implementation internals.
No global browser storage or existing user descriptions are modified by tests.
Use Node tests for byte policy, failure-preserving storage, URL normalization and schema guards.
Use generated assertions for the actual API shortcut and edition citation location.
Require a focused isolated-browser acceptance pass for navigation, focus and storage-recovery wiring; a recorded executable checklist is acceptable initially.
Avoid broad snapshots, mirrored implementation tests and access to real user storage.

completion_review.qualification: Scope and unexecuted-example limits remain as specified in the acceptance criteria and review evidence.
